correctness.rationale: Define Σ-type of each local point and keep one original component per distinct root Σ-signature (preserving the distinguished component). In each chosen component order retained local Σ-types by inclusion. For each false □ψ of a representative root retain an original successor-root witness; every true □χ remains true at selected successor roots. Induction on Σ proves atomic, implication and □ truth at every retained local type: false implications have an original upward extension whose type remains in the filtered component. Counts are ≤2^s components and ≤2^s points each. Original paper establishes soundness/completeness of iK+bem for these concrete mixed models, yielding FMP and a coNEXPTIME upper bound by finite countermodel guessing. Independently checked a constructed two-component Kripke model across seven modal/implicational formulas; finite diagnostic cannot replace unrestricted induction.
